name: trend-only-subsignals-120m-threshold-015
rationale: Cost-side, internal pattern (2026-11-10 lead #2). Raising trend-only spacing 600s -> 3600s kept ~90% of the gross timing value (+2.29 -> +2.06 pp zero-cost excess at 500k) while cutting trades 209 -> 87 and fees 17,183 -> 10,761 JPY. The dose-response is still steep on the cost side and flat on the gross side, so this tests the next dose, 7200s, with the identical trend-only weights and threshold 0.15. Score on total_fees_jpy and excess_return_vs_static_mix_pct at 500k as well as the 50k promotion rule.
code_change_summary: In TradingEngine::compute_btc_target (src/trading/engine.rs), set TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 0.25 to 1.0 and REVERSION_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 1.0 to 0.0. After computing weight_sum, return None if weight_sum <= 0.0 (only reversion sub-signals present during partial warmup) so the result is never NaN. Update both constants' doc comments and add a NOTE naming this hypothesis. Update compute_btc_target_* unit tests' expected values where they legitimately change (rewrite, never delete, tests asserting reversion dominance) and add a regression test that an RSI-only IndicatorPoint returns None and a trend-only point returns the expected value. Cherry-picking experiment/trend-only-subsignals-60m-threshold-015 (7d353d3) is fine since the code change is identical. Run that 60m variant's config (rebalance_interval_secs 3600) with the same code on the same window at all three capitals as an unregistered reference, plus both it and this variant at --fee-pct 0 --slippage-pct 0 at 500k to separate gross timing value from cost.
constraints: This hypothesis modifies the body of TradingEngine::compute_btc_target. This change MUST be made only on this hypothesis's own dedicated isolation: "worktree" branch -- never as a direct commit to dev/main.
MUST NOT change TradingEngine::compute_btc_target's signature (its parameter list or return type) -- only its body.

MUST NOT change any individual sub-signal's own formula or the aggregation expression; exactly two numeric constants change (TREND 0.25 -> 1.0 and REVERSION 1.0 -> 0.0). Because REVERSION becomes 0.0 the weighted-mean denominator can be zero when only RSI/%B are present (partial warmup): handle that by returning None when weight_sum <= 0.0, and document it.

MUST pass `cargo test`, including the compute_btc_target_* unit tests in src/trading/engine.rs -- update their expected values if the new weight legitimately changes them (do not weaken or delete a test just to make it pass).

A promoted change still becomes its own PR against dev (per the pipeline's step 6) and is never merged automatically -- a human reviews it like any other algorithm hypothesis. Flag explicitly in the PR description that this diff touches compute_btc_target's body, so the reviewer gives it the scrutiny an allocation-formula change deserves.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or anything on the live order-submission path.
